description: In a state where gun violence is the leading cause of death for children, it is morally reprehensible that our Republican supermajority has proposed laws to make it easier to attain an assault weapon and shielded gun manufacturers from liability. By placing the profits and contributions of the firearm lobby over the lives of kids, gun extremists have held our democracy at gunpoint long enough, and now is the time for real, comprehensive gun reform.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Justin Jones - Treasurer Lynne Mcfarland
title: Protect Kids, Not Guns - Justin Jones
